checks.name: valid_json
checks.description: All JSON files parse without error
checks.detail: review_report.json, kf_result.json, selfcheck.json, review_checks.json all parse successfully with json.loads

checks.name: quote_integrity
checks.description: All evidence quotes are substrings of the source markdown

checks.name: derived_metrics_recomputed
checks.description: All derived metrics are recomputable from source data

checks.name: no_self_verified_claims
checks.description: No claim is marked as verified by the reviewer
checks.detail: All claims use judgement values from {supports, qualifies, refutes, insufficient}; none use 'verified'

checks.name: verdict_consistency
checks.description: Verdict is consistent with findings (blocker → needs-fix)
checks.detail: 1 blocker finding (F1) present; verdict is 'needs-fix' as required

checks.name: finding_severity_ranked
checks.description: Findings are ranked by severity (blocker > major > minor)
checks.detail: F1=blocker, F2-F5=major, F6-F8=minor; ordering is correct

checks.name: independence_declared
checks.description: Reviewer independence is declared and limitations documented

checks.name: checks_not_run_declared
checks.description: Checks not run are explicitly listed (unknown ≠ pass)
